'''Teardrop rebel base''' was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] outpost on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teardrop]]. It was used before [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]], when it was evacuated only moments before the arrival of [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial'' class Star Destroyer]] [[Reprisal (Imperial II-class)|''Reprisal'']], which had been sent to root out the Rebels.
